reader.requirement: At --std 85 SORT file-name-1 must be a file described by an SD; an FD file is refused, and since COBOL-85 has no table SORT, any other operand (a table, a record, an undefined name) is refused too.

edition-consulted.switches: construct table-sort-2002 (ConstructRegistry, COBOL0870): a SORT with no USING / GIVING / procedure phrases is refused below 2002

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 a table operand is refused (COBOL0870); from 2002 it is Format 2. The SD check itself (SortBindFile, !IsSortMerge) is the same at every edition
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness is the FD-file refusal; non-file operands at 85 are not witnessed

probes.printed: EXIT 0: SORT S1 USING F1 GIVING F2; 1 AA111 / 2 BB222
COBOL1757: SORT file F1 is not described in a sort-merge description entry
COBOL0870: SORT of a table (Format 2) requires COBOL-2002
COBOL1757: SORT of NOSUCH: USING/GIVING/INPUT/OUTPUT PROCEDURE apply only to a sort-merge FILE operand (Format 2 sorts the table in place)
COBOL1757: the same message for SORT R (the SD record) USING ... GIVING ...

citations.check: OK  §1985:XI.4.4.3 SR2  (4.4.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR2 [File-name-1 must be described in a sort-merge file description entry in the Data Division]

reader.notes: Every non-SD operand is refused at --std 85. One wording nit: at 85, a non-file operand written with USING/GIVING draws the Format-2 message ('Format 2 sorts the table in place'), which talks about a format 1985 does not have. The refusal itself is correct.

refuter.evidence: Probes at --std 85: x5a (SORT of an FD file with INPUT PROCEDURE and GIVING) refused COBOL1757 'F1' is not described in a sort-merge description entry; x5b (SORT of an FD file with no USING/GIVING/procedure phrase) refused COBOL1757 plus COBOL0870; x5c (2002 table SORT with WITH DUPLICATES, a later edition's form) refused COBOL0870 at 85. Diagnostics cite §2023 clause numbers at --std 85 (citation nit only). cite.py: OK  §1985:XI.4.4.3 SR2 [File-name-1 must be described in a sort-merge file description entry].
